subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

Rarely had the court encountered a petition (1)/ so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended (2)/ to attract media attention rather than judicial remedy. (3)/ No error (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in **part 2** of the sentence.
 
• The phrase "so devoid of legal merit, nor so conspicuously intended" is incorrect because "nor" is used incorrectly in this context.
 
• "Nor" is generally used in negative sentences following "neither." Here, "and" would be appropriate instead of
